text:
maria: FYI i opened a quick docs PR — noticed the GET /v1/search query param `cursor` got documented as required by mistake after the schema reshape. this is breaking a few SDK examples.

alex: thanks for flagging. link? i'll grab it and patch the snippets

maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/456

sasha: saw this in the SDK tests too — go client expects `cursor` optional, python example uses no cursor. we should keep it optional and add a migration note

alex: on it. looks like openapi.yml had `required: [cursor]` under parameters which caused the generated examples to include it. i'll change that to optional and regenerate snippets.

maria: also need to update the request/response example in api-ref/search.md — the response example shows `next_cursor` as `null` but real responses return an empty string when none. small but users copy/paste tests fail.

sasha: good catch. open a tiny follow-up commit for that example. i'll update the python snippet to demonstrate optional cursor usage and default behavior.

alex: patch pushed to the PR — removed `cursor` from required and added a `description` clarifying empty string semantics. regenerated SDK snippets in docs/snippets/python/search_example.py

maria: can you paste the updated python snippet here so i can sanity-check before merge?

alex: sure

alex: ```python
from redwood import Client

client = Client()
# cursor is optional — omit for first page
resp = client.search(q="relevance", limit=20)
print(resp.hits)
# to continue paging use resp.next_cursor if non-empty
if resp.next_cursor:
    next_page = client.search(q="relevance", cursor=resp.next_cursor)
```

sasha: looks good. also added a small migration blurb under docs/migrations.md: "If you previously passed `cursor=''` treat empty string as no cursor; new clients will omit param by default." short and clear.

maria: docs-bot: deploy preview for PR 456?

docs-bot: CI started for redwood-inference/docs#456 — build 892

docs-bot: Build 892 passed ✅ — preview available: https://deploy-preview-456--docs.redwood.ai

maria: preview looks fine. examples rendered correctly and the openapi param table shows `cursor` not required. i'll merge after CI green for main.

alex: merging now. thanks all :tada:

sasha: nice, will bump the SDK examples release note in changelog.

maria: closing the loop: once SDK release is out we'll announce the tiny migration note in release notes and Slack #general. done.
